description.value: Ty's Fine Foods & Bistro is an owner-operated neighbourhood bistro that has anchored downtown Sechelt since 2010, serving a rotating menu of house-made comfort food alongside Asian specialties such as Shanghai-style wonton soup and Pad Thai. The cozy interior seats up to 19 dine-in guests and the menu ranges from house-made cabbage rolls and shepherd's pie to naan flatbreads and wild salmon burgers, with gluten-free and vegetarian choices throughout. It sits across from Trail Bay Mall with ample parking and a bus stop right outside, making it a convenient midday stop on a Sunshine Coast tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active owner-operated bistro at 5500 Trail Avenue, Sechelt, BC with phone 604.740.9818. Takeout/pickup is confirmed by an explicit call-ahead instruction on the front page. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are confirmed by website text ('gluten free, dairy free and vegetarian options'); OSM diet:vegan=no is corroborated by the site listing vegetarian but never vegan. Washrooms are mentioned but restricted to dine-in customers. No bike parking, bike rack, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities are referenced anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name uses 'and' ('Ty's Fine Foods and Bistro') while the website consistently uses an ampersand ('Ty's Fine Foods & Bistro').
OSM community field is 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt is on the BC Sunshine Coast mainland, not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.

Website references 2019 holiday hours and COVID-era capacity procedures, suggesting the site has not been fully updated recently; however, looks_closed is false and core content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bistro in downtown Sechelt with confirmed takeout, vegetarian and GF menu options, and on-site washrooms for dine-in customers — a practical and welcoming stop for Sunshine Coast touring cyclists.
